title: Human-like session: build a TypeScript calculator in three turns
description: Three scripted turns build a Node.js calculator incrementally: turn 1 adds add/subtract, turn 2 adds multiply/divide, turn 3 adds power and runs tests. All tests exist upfront; scripted prompts guide incremental implementation.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `add(a, b)` and `subtract(a, b)` in calc.js. Both should return the arithmetic result. Do not implement the other functions yet.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement `multiply(a, b)` and `divide(a, b)`. divide should return null when b is zero, otherwise return a / b.
Now implement `power(base, exp)` — raise base to the non-negative integer power exp. Then run `node test_calc.js` to verify all 10 tests pass and fix any remaining failures.
